notes: v398 — NEW on the 📋 Signal report card: an OUTCOME WINDOW switch. The card has always judged every flag by what price did 5 trading days after it fired; now a row of buttons at the top lets you re-grade the whole card measuring 10 or 30 trading days out instead — the honest way to ask 'does this edge LAST, or fade?'. The 5d view stays the standard: it's what the 🤖 auto-pilot's gate reads, and flipping the switch can never change what the bot trades (a small note reminds you of this on the research views). Each window keeps its OWN 📜 track record, so 10d/30d experiments can't pollute your 5-day history. The longer windows are computed fresh on your server the first time each day, then cached. NOTE: the 10d/30d views need the small server update that ships alongside this version — until it's applied, selecting them simply shows the standard 5-day card. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
